info.name: Task Manager API — Step 8
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman tests for the Django REST Task Manager at http://127.0.0.1:8000.

**Run order:** Execute folder **00 Setup** first, then folders 01–09 in numeric order.

**Idempotency keys:** The first request in 00 Setup generates `idempotencyKeyCreate`, `idempotencyKeyFromText`, and `idempotencyKeyBreakdown` once per collection run (via `pm.variables.replaceIn('{{$randomUUID}}')`). Re-run the whole collection or clear variables to generate new keys.

**Paginated list:** `{ count, next, previous, results }` (page size 10).

**Error envelope:** `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details": [{ "field", "issue" }] } }` — collection includes `assertCustomErrorFn` for Tests scripts.

**Note:** Folder 05 overwrites `breakdownParentId` with a subtask id only after happy-path breakdown; folder 04 must run before dependent subtaskId tests.

item.name: 10 Mock-only scenarios (documented, not runnable in Postman)
item.description:
These cases require pytest/unittest with unittest.mock.patch on tasks.ai.parse_task_text or break_down_task:

- Parser returns non-dict → 502 PARSER_ERROR
- Parser raises Exception → 502 PARSER_ERROR
- Parser returns dict failing TaskSerializer → 502 PARSER_VALIDATION_ERROR (empty title, bad types)
- break_down_task returns invalid items → 502 BREAKDOWN_VALIDATION_ERROR; assert DB subtask count unchanged

See tasks/tests.py for serializer-level coverage; add API tests with APIClient + mock.
